dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part III
dialogues.text: ...These are the words of the sovereign ruler Aj K'astajibal Cha'ama' Ho'o...

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part III
dialogues.text: ...Thrice-damned wretched worms... I wish not to gaze upon such... crude misuse of Phlogiston... Such shameful barbarism!

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part III
dialogues.text: ...Had my proposal not been rejected by the traitors... would you have...

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part III
dialogues.text: ...Wretched... vile... ignorant worms, sing your songs of joy! Expend your final breaths wailing praise for this short-lived reprieve...

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part III
dialogues.text: ...Soon, the Lord of Light and Heat will expunge you all in flame. While we... in the fire's embrace...

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part III
dialogues.text: ...My king... Great and glorious Xiuhcoatl, you alone must not...
